sources.title: SCSTRTI · Trilingual booklets
sources.note: The trilingual-booklet catalogue lists Kui and Kuvi separately, alongside the other language-labelled resources mentioned here. Catalogue labels provide starting points for reading; they do not establish a complete language inventory or describe every speaker.

sources.title: President of India · Ol Chiki centenary, 16 February 2026
sources.note: The President’s Secretariat release of 16 February 2026, paragraphs 2–3, credits Raghunath Murmu with creating Ol Chiki in 1925 and describes earlier scripts used for Santali. The script’s date does not date the language.

sources.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011
sources.note: Retained original C-16 workbook, Sheet1, rows 96–105: ODIA is the parent group; Desia and Sambalpuri are constituent entries (rows 100 and 104). The workbook was inspected; the current catalogue page timed out. These are 2011 mother-tongue returns, not current population estimates or ethnic-community counts.
